codebase.description: Visual, offline-first tactical command center for AI-assisted software development, managing context compression, constraints, and architecture visualizations.

module.name: @electron/notarize
module.purpose: Interacts with Apple's Notary Service to securely upload and staple notarization tickets to macOS applications.

module.name: adm-zip
module.purpose: Synchronous zip extraction utility used for restoring ecosystem backups and unpacking database archives directly over the active user data directory.

module.name: archiver
module.purpose: Streaming interface for archive generation, used to bundle the SQLite database and physical attachment directories into a single ZIP file.

module.name: better-sqlite3
module.purpose: Synchronous SQLite3 driver for robust, atomic local database transactions.

module.name: d3
module.purpose: Data-driven document library for rendering complex orthogonal network and relationship graphs.

module.name: docx
module.purpose: Used for generating and exporting Word documents from compiled specification and architecture markdowns.

module.name: dotenv
module.purpose: Loads environment variables from the .env file into process.env for secure credential management.

module.name: electron-store
module.purpose: Simple data persistence for saving user preferences and UI states (like window dimensions and active modules) across sessions.

module.name: fast-xml-parser
module.purpose: High-performance XML parser used by the Codebase Explorer to ingest and traverse the codebase.xml manifest.

module.name: pdfkit
module.purpose: Used for generating and exporting PDF documents from the Document Management System.
